items.r0.002_a1.25: After being expelled from the Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) due to alleged anti-party activities, the Indian politician **Kuldeep Singh Sengar** joined the **Samajwadi Party** and won a seat from the **Kanpur Nagar constituency** in the 2007 Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly elections.
